text: The WORM is given to Peter the Parrot to get a hint about a puzzle.

subject: Secondary weapons
text: Secondary weapons are found and have limited uses.

evidence.quote: Secondary: These are found and have limited uses.

subject: BASEBALL BAT
text: The Baseball Bat should only be used when the player has fewer than six heart containers.

evidence.quote: Only use it when ...you are under six heart containers.

subject: BASEBALL BAT
text: The Baseball Bat is only a little stronger than the Shooting Star.

evidence.quote: is only a little stronger than the Shooting Star.

subject: BASEBALLS
text: Baseballs are only used on one boss and can be thrown across the screen.

evidence.quote: These are only used on one boss, and can be thrown all the way ...across the screen.

subject: BOLAS
text: Bolas are not strong, but they can fly across the screen.

evidence.quote: They are not strong at all, but can fly across the screen.

subject: LASER GUN
text: The Laser Gun does about as much damage as the Shooting Star.

evidence.quote: does about as much damage as the Shooting Star does.

subject: MAGIC MIRROR
text: The Magic Mirror sends projectiles back at the enemies that shoot them.

evidence.quote: send projectiles back at the enemies that shoot them.

subject: Queen of SheCola
text: The Queen of SheCola gives the Shooting Star in chapter 3.

evidence.quote: You get this from the Queen of SheCola in chapter 3.

subject: SHOOTING STAR
text: The Shooting Star can only be used with six or more heart containers filled.

evidence.quote: It can only be used if you have six heart containers filled or more.

subject: SHOOTING STAR
text: If fewer than six heart containers are filled, the Shooting Star turns back into a Yo-Yo.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, it ...turns back into a yoyo.

subject: SLINGSHOT
text: The Slingshot is super strong but has only the limited range of the Yo-Yo.

evidence.quote: They are super strong, but only have the limited range of the YoYo.

subject: SPIKE SHOES
text: Spike Shoes attack every enemy on the screen for decent damage.

evidence.quote: every enemy on the screen for decent damage.
